title: Protocol for isolation and analysis of the leukemia stem cells in BCR-ABL-driven chronic myelogenous leukemia mice
protocol: Pretreat male donor C57BL/6 mice (6–8 weeks) with 5-fluorouracil (200 mg/kg) via tail vein injection for 5 days.

Collect bone marrow cells and incubate them with cytokines including stem cell factor (SCF, 50 ng/mL), interleukin-3 (IL-3, 6 ng/mL), and IL-6 (6 ng/mL) for 24 hours at 37°C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2.
Transduce bone marrow cells twice with MSCV-BCR-ABL-IRES-GFP retrovirus (1,500 × g, 90 minutes, 32°C).
Transplant the infected bone marrow cells into sublethally irradiated (550 cGy) female recipient C57BL/6 mice (6–8 weeks) via tail vein injection.
Obtain chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) mice at day 14 post transplantation.
Sacrifice CML mice by cervical dislocation or other approved method.
Generate cell suspension from bone marrow and spleen of CML mice.
Snip the skin over the midsection using scissors and tweezers.
Isolate the spleen and place in a sterile 6 cm dish containing BM flush buffer.
Cut the spleen into small tissue pieces using scissors.
Grind tissue pieces by the plunger of a 1 ml syringe on ice.
Add 2 ml of BM flush buffer to the dish, break down tissue homogenates by pipetting several times with a 1 ml pipette tip.
Transfer suspension into a sterile 50 ml tube through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Snip the skin over hind legs using scissors.
Pull the skin apart using tweezers.
Hold one hind leg via tweezers and cut off the hip joint using scissors.
Transfer the dissected leg into a sterile 6 cm dish containing 1 mL BM flush buffer.
Repeat the process for the other hind leg.
Remove adherent muscle from hind legs using scissors.
Dissect hind legs into femurs and tibias on ice.
Hold each bone with tweezers.
Insert the needle of a 1 mL syringe containing 1 mL of BM flush buffer into the marrow cavity.
Flush the bone marrow into a sterile 50 mL tube through a 40 μm cell strainer, repeat this procedure six times for each bone.
Repeat the flushing procedure for all bones.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g for 10 min.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet with 10 mL of erythrocyte lysis buffer.
Incubate on ice for 5 min.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g for 10 min.
Sort GFP+ cells from BM and splenic cell suspension.
Filter the cell suspension through a 40 μm cell strainer to remove clumps.
Count the cells and prepare a suspension of 1 × 10^7 cells/mL in 0.5% BSA buffer in a falcon tube.
Keep the samples on ice until cell sorting.
Prepare a 15 mL tube containing 1 mL of 0.5% BSA buffer.
Add 10 μL penicillin/streptomycin solution to the tube.
Keep all tubes, solutions, and sorted cells on ice during sorting.
Perform cell sorting using BD FACS Aria II with 407/488/633 lasers.
Use a 100 μm nozzle with a sorting speed of 6,000–8,000 events/second.
Set appropriate PMT voltages and gating strategy using BM or splenic cells from normal mice as negative controls.
Sort GFP+ cells by flow cytometry into tubes.
Transfer sorted cells onto ice to maintain viability.
Analyze the percentage of GFP+ cells in the sorted population by flow cytometry.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 800 × g for 10 min.
Aspirate supernatant completely after centrifugation.
Add 500 μL of 0.5% BSA buffer to the cell pellet.
Count the cells after adding BSA buffer.
Place 10^7 cells in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 300 × g for 10 min.
Aspirate supernatant completely after centrifugation.
Resuspend cell pellet with 80 μL of 0.5% BSA buffer.
Add 20 μL of CD117 microbeads per 10^7 cells to the resuspended cell mixture.
Mix well and incubate on ice for 15 minutes.
Wash the cells with 1 mL of 0.5% BSA buffer.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant completely.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 50 μL of 0.5% BSA buffer.
Set up the MS column against the magnetic MACS™ Multistand.
Place a 15 mL tube under the MS column to collect c-Kit- cells.
Add 500 μL of 0.5% BSA buffer to rinse the column.
Wait until the column is empty before adding cell suspension or buffer.
Add cell suspension into the column.
Collect the buffer containing unlabeled (GFP+c-Kit-) cells to a 15 mL tube.
Wash the column with 500 μL of 0.5% BSA buffer.
Remove the column from the separator.
Add 500 μL of 0.5% BSA buffer to the column and immediately flush out the labeled c-Kit+ cells to a new 15 mL tube.
Determine the purity of sorted c-Kit+ cells by flow cytometry.
Count the cells, and use 10^6 cells/sample for antibody staining.
Centrifuge the cells at 800 × g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL of 0.5% BSA buffer.
Add 0.5 μL of isotype control or c-Kit-PE antibody to the cells at 4°C in dark for 30 min.
Add 1 mL of 0.5% BSA buffer to the cells.
Centrifuge the cells at 800 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 400 μL of 0.5% BSA buffer.
Set appropriate PMT voltages and compensation using isotype control.
Analyze the percentage of c-Kit+ cells by flow cytometry.
Count the sorted GFP+c-Kit- and GFP+c-Kit+ cells.
Place 25,000 cells in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 800 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 50 μL of PBS.
Add to 450 μL of MethoCult M3434.
Vortex the tube vigorously to mix the contents thoroughly.
Let the tube stand for at least 5 min to allow bubbles to rise to the top.
Attach a sterile 16 gauge blunt-end needle to a sterile 1 mL syringe.
Draw up the MethoCult mixture containing cells into the syringe.
Dispense a volume of 100 μL into individual wells of a 96-well plate (5,000 cells/well).
Incubate at 37°C in 5% CO2 with ≥ 95% humidity.
After 7 days, count all the colonies in each well using microscope.
Using a 1 mL pipettor, add 200 μL of PBS to each well.
Pipette up and down gently to mix the methylcellulose-based medium with the cells.
Transfer the diluted methylcellulose and the cells into a 4 mL Eppendorf tube.
Repeat steps for adding 200 μL of PBS, mixing, and transferring three times.
Add an additional 2 mL PBS to the tube to ensure that the methylcellulose is completely diluted.
Centrifuge the cells at 800 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 1 mL of PBS.
Repeat steps for adding 200 μL of PBS, mixing, and transferring as described.
Centrifuge the BM or splenic cell suspension at 800 × g for 10 min, aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL of 0.5% BSA buffer.
Stain 10^6 cells/sample at 4°C in dark using different anti-mouse antibodies combined with fluorophore listed in key resources table for 30 min.
Add 1 ml of 0.5% BSA buffer to the sample and centrifuge at 800 × g for 10 min, aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 400 μL of 0.5% BSA buffer.
The samples are now ready for analysis by flow cytometry.
Set appropriate PMT voltages and compensation using unstained or single-stained controls.
Adjust compensation using the same set of antibodies used in the panel.
Define the gating strategy for flow cytometry analysis.
Collect data using BD LSRFortessa flow cytometry.
